architecture.summary: Test support only: the local HTTPS site of the hosted live gate (test/support/hosted-live/local-https-site.ts and settings.ts) moves from the fixed port 46443, inside the Linux ephemeral port range, to 24443, and the Connect callback of the live proofs from 46480 to 24480; both ports are below the ephemeral ranges of Linux (32768 to 60999) and macOS (49152 to 65535). The two loopback fronts of the site move to the new module test/support/hosted-live/https-fronts.ts; they listen before the application opens, and a busy fixed port stops the start at once with one error that names the port and the likely cause. The hosted-live-site integration cases need no registered URI, so their sites listen on port 0 and their requests go to the front address. The live gate files start the site before their first WorkOS call. The live describe names, the fetch proofs, the work slice launcher and guide, the test gate policy, the test list, README.md, and docs/user-portal.md name the new port. The WorkOS Staging URIs of the new ports are configuration outside Git. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment change.
